summary: PennantPark Private Income Fund filed an 8-K solely to declare a monthly distribution of $0.175 per share payable September 29, 2026, to shareholders of record September 22, 2026, from taxable net investment income. No special-situation transaction is involved; it is a routine distribution announcement. Tax characteristics will be reported on Form 1099-DIV in early 2027. The registrant acts as the issuer of the distribution, with no acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, or other strategic event occurring. This is a standard monthly dividend declaration with no deal terms, premium, expected close, or structural mechanics to analyze—no risk-arb angle applies.
